summary: Register durable mailbox expiry outcomes and preserve later delivery evidence without enabling automatic expiry

replay.detail: The graph registry admits daemon/runtime message.expired claims with explicit reason codes. Later delivered/read evidence remains admissible and supersedes the expiry outcome while its claim stays in history. No production expiry writer or recovery-policy change is enabled.

schema.detail: Adds the durable message.expired graph claim kind and a store outcome reader. The messages shard still replicates only message.sent; no local receipt-table format changes.

rules.detail: message.expired is durable retention history, not a transport receipt or proof of non-consumption. Transactional notification entry points cannot bypass expiry admission; late delivered evidence after read remains admissible.

compatibility.detail: The registry digest changes. Older registries retain expiry as an unknown kind and cannot interpret the outcome. Deploy all outcome readers, projections and sender surfaces to every pinned host before enabling a writer. Harness receipt authorization is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No data migration or startup rebuild is introduced.

manual.detail: This release enables no expiry writer and requires no operator action.

recovery.detail: Rollback retains authenticated expiry history as an unknown kind on older readers; it does not authorize replay of an uncertain handoff. Do not enable expiry writers until the full reader rollout is complete.
